'''Beverly Blvd''' was a destination on Coruscant's subtram in the Coruscant underworld.

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map, referencing the main east-west thorougfare, Beverly Boulevard, in Los Angeles, California.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
